caption: The drawing depicts a single object situated slightly to the right of center on a plain, off-white background. The object is a flask-shaped container with a bulbous body that tapers into a cylindrical neck. The body of the flask is a brownish-red color, appearing to be made of tooled or embossed leather with visible stitching along the edges, and decorated with an embossed design that includes ornately detailed foliage and possibly animals. The neck of the flask is metallic, with a gold or brass hue, and contains a mechanical dispensing mechanism attached to the end, consisting of levers and a spring-like component. At the narrow end of the flask body near the base, there is a small metal ring. The overall composition is simple, with the object isolated and occupying much of the lower half of the image, accompanied by a small, neat artist's signature in the lower right corner.
title: Powder Flask
